title: Higher Schwarzians
summary: The classical Schwarzian can be computed directly from the coefficients of a second-order linear equation. We extend this coefficient viewpoint to monic operators of arbitrary order over unital associative differential algebras over the rationals. The normalized coefficients freely generate the universal gauge covariants under covariant differentiation. Projective normalization in the scalar case, followed by symmetrization, gives higher Schwarzians with compatible finite laws under changes of frame and parameter.
